mission: Ben on Coruscant without the memory of the trip; unease without object.
why_now: The erasure has been performed on the return trip.
opening_hook: Ben in his family apartment looking at his own hands, a stretch of time missing.
conflict: Ben's apprentice trust in Jacen vs. the visceral missing-time register his Force-sensitivity cannot fully suppress.
turning_point: Ben files the missing-time register away — for now.
closing_hook: Ben leaving the apartment for training without asking the question.
sensory_details: Morning light; apartment's familiar quiet; Ben's hands in his lap.
emotional_trajectory: Missing-time register → suppressed inquiry → exit to routine.

stakes.interpersonal: The mentor-bond now carrying a buried secret.
